itemListElement.name: Read AI vs Otter AI in 2026: Which Should US Teams Pick?

mainEntity.name: Is Read AI or Otter AI better for meetings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Otter is better for live transcription and lower cost. Read AI is better for engagement analytics, coaching and shareable reports. Pick based on whether you need a record of what was said or feedback on how the meeting went. Test both on real calls.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Otter AI and Read AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: Otter AI focuses on live, searchable transcripts. Read AI focuses on meeting reports with engagement, talk-time and coaching insights. Both summarize meetings and list action items. Otter suits people who reread what was said; Read AI suits managers who want feedback on how meetings went and how to run the next one better.

mainEntity.name: Is Read AI cheaper than Otter?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Read AI Pro costs $15 a month billed yearly versus $8.33 for Otter Pro. On monthly billing, Read AI Pro is $19.75 and Otter Pro is $16.99. For a 10-person team on annual billing, that is about $1,800 a year for Read AI Pro versus $1,000 for Otter Pro.

mainEntity.name: Does Read AI show a live transcript like Otter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Read AI offers live notes during meetings, including on its free plan (5 sessions a month). Otter's live transcript is its core feature and is available on every plan. Read AI's free plan caps each meeting at 1 hour, while Otter's free plan cuts each conversation at 30 minutes.

mainEntity.name: Which is better for Microsoft Teams, Read AI or Otter?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both join Microsoft Teams meetings. Read AI also offers a Microsoft Teams marketplace app. If your company prefers built-in tools, Teams' AI recap requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Both join as a visible participant, so tell attendees at the start of the call.

mainEntity.name: Do Read AI and Otter support languages other than English?

acceptedAnswer.text: Read AI lists support for 20+ languages. Otter focuses mainly on English. Lynkk supports 17 languages plus auto-detect, including Hindi and a Hinglish setting for mixed Hindi and English.
